crossRefs.note: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, Yahweh has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will…
Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.
Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
translations.bsb: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.
translations.kjv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
translations.asv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the freewoman.
